organization_note: Google DeepMind develops the models. Google LLC, of Mountain View and the largest of Alphabet Inc.'s companies, offers the Gemini API, the Gemini apps, and the developer tools, while Google Cloud operates the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, formerly Vertex AI. The catalog names the developer Google for most releases and Google DeepMind for one, and names the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform operator Google Cloud, so all three names belong to this record. The unit that develops them is not where the entity is headquartered: DeepMind's own careers page lists ten locations, London first among them, with the Bay Area, New York City, Cambridge (US), Bangalore, Montreal, Paris, Tokyo, Toronto, and Zurich beside it, so the research that produces the catalog's releases is spread across those cities rather than sitting under the Mountain View address this record is named for. Its about page says DeepMind started in 2010 and names no city, so the record does not assert where it began and carries the United Kingdom as the site that distinguishes it from the headquarters.
